exemptions.reason: Checkpoint capture, integrity, retention, and restore entrypoints intentionally share one fail-closed recovery contract; focused checkpoint tests, recovery tests, CLI integration tests, and the full repository gate cover all consumers.
This binary-only command adapter exposes one parent-visible dispatch function after splitting main.rs; checkpoint unit tests and cross-process CLI integration tests cover its behavior.

This module contains the immutable authored-message template catalog used to prove complete English coverage without mutating dynamic Unicode; exact source/catalog equality, every-template localization, dynamic-value preservation, CLI integration tests, and the full repository gate cover the executable logic.

Goal contracts, receipt types, and the state store intentionally form the shared fail-closed lifecycle boundary; focused goal tests, CLI integration tests, and repeated repository authority gates cover all consumers.

GoalStore remains the single fail-closed transaction boundary for baseline-bound goal state, workspace CAS checks, legacy quarantine, and atomic persistence. Deterministic plan-publication hashing, state conversion, and envelope validation now live in goal/plan_publication.rs; focused goal tests, CLI integration tests, and the full repository gate cover the remaining transactional module.

This OS advisory-lock module is shared by the goal store and checkpoint restore, which is why it sits at the crate root; focused contention and ACL classification tests run through the goal test module and the full repository gate.

Inter-process advisory locking for managed state is intentionally one module: the goal store, the pending store, checkpoint restore, and the Codex hook installer must all serialize on the same lock identity and share one contention/ACL classification. Focused contention tests, checkpoint restore tests, and the full repository gate exercise every caller together.

Clap command schemas are intentionally centralized so main dispatch, the Codex Stop hook, and focused command adapters share one parsed contract; CLI integration tests and the full repository gate cover all consumers.

Codex home resolution, patch availability, and Windows token fact collection remain one host adapter; client-neutral execution-context normalization and classification now live in execution_context.rs. Focused host/context tests, CLI integration tests, and the full repository gate cover both layers.

Workspace activation and source identity are intentionally centralized as the shared fail-closed boundary; workspace unit tests, CLI integration tests, and the full repository gate cover every consumer.

Workspace activation is one handle-bound, metadata-preserving transaction across Windows and Linux; no-follow identity checks, staging, publication, rollback, retained evidence, and action-specific capability probes share private state so every failure path is audited together. Platform-focused workspace tests, CLI integration tests, and the full repository gate cover the module; splitting this security boundary requires a dedicated cross-platform refactor rather than a release-closure edit.
UTC receipt timestamps are intentionally centralized in one tiny helper; goal, pending, checkpoint, and autosave behavior tests plus the full root suite cover every consumer.
This is the single cross-process CLI contract suite; its 80 isolated behavioral cases are run in full by check-repo and audit-repository, while production logic remains split into focused modules.

Atomic file replacement and durable-write helpers are intentionally centralized; focused file_io tests plus the full root suite validate all callers together.

Managed-state containment is a shared security boundary by design; the full root suite and release self-dogfood validate all state consumers together.
